_comment: A save slot in the shape SaveOverlay wrote through v1.3.9: no schema, no
groupId, no worldId, no roster, and a form carrying age instead of a birth
year. Pinned so the migration has something real to run against rather than
something written to make it pass.
The cast is TWICE on purpose. red_velvet is both the app's default selection
and the migrator's last-resort fallback, so a save of Red Velvet would pass
every check while the group scan did nothing at all.
jeongyeon, momo, sana, mina and chaeyoung are not in the form: they are the
NPCs today's getNpcMembers derives, and reproducing that set exactly is the
